cards.card: Typhoid — Evidence provided: several days of vomiting and diarrhea, difficulty staying hydrated, mild fever, and stomach pain. These symptoms are nonspecific; no exposure history or confirmatory testing is given.
Dry, flaky skin patches with peeling on the knees and elbows, alongside joint pain, support psoriasis.
Red, scaly skin patches that are itchy and painful support psoriasis.
Itchy skin spots that may be red, bumpy, or a different color from surrounding skin, with some bumps described as little balls, support the label fungal infection.
Dengue-labeled case: substantial joint pain making walking difficult, loss of appetite, marked weakness, and nausea.
Several days of fever followed by painful sores near the nose and discomfort supports impetigo.
Dengue: evidence is a widespread itchy rash, reduced appetite, and pronounced fatigue. No fever, bleeding, pain, or test results are reported, so symptoms alone do not confirm dengue.
Several days of very watery, foul-smelling diarrhea with severe headache and nausea/feeling like vomiting → typhoid.
Common cold: frequent sneezing, fatigue, mucus in the nose and throat, sore throat, and a swollen-feeling neck.
Neck pain is the input evidence supporting cervical spondylosis. Lightheadedness and trouble standing still are also reported but do not independently establish the diagnosis.
Longstanding, severe one-sided headaches with nausea, vomiting, and sensitivity to light and sound support migraine.
Hypertension: reported trouble concentrating and focusing, dizziness, headache, and chest pain. No blood-pressure reading or diagnostic history is provided.
Neck pain with limb weakness and unsteadiness (weak on feet) supports cervical spondylosis; back pain, chronic cough, and disorientation were also reported.
Frequent cough with difficulty breathing and abundant mucus, accompanied by fatigue and fever; correct label: bronchial asthma.
Worsening rash on the legs with difficulty running → varicose veins.
Chicken pox: red, itchy bumps across the body, especially arms and legs, with headache, fever, and loss of appetite.
